audit.whatIsWrong: diff read EVEN while diffRating is 8.5/10, the tone is the hard colour and report[14] says 'Hard matchup'. Two chart rows also contradicted their whys: win[2] said Teemo while whys[2] calls it 'an even skirmish', win[4] said Teemo while whys[4] says All Out shreds him and runs him down.
audit.why: One page cannot answer 'how hard is this' two ways, and Level 6 is the one stage where a 680-range Teemo has no answer to an R that launches him through a wall.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN -> HARD; Level 3 = Skill (5/10), Level 6 = K'Sante (6/10) in matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike credited All Out with 'range and penetration'.
audit.why: Riot's text for All Out grants increased damage, healing and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses — no range, no penetration. The real level-6 mechanic is the R wall-launch onto a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: Both spikes[2] and mid re-grounded on the wall-launch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart's cooldown was never given, Q3 was called a knock-up (it pulls), and the TL;DR sells his damage as '%HP'.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank — that is a long, countable window, and it is the single number that makes 'bait it then commit' actionable. Teemo has no percent-health damage anywhere in his kit; Toxic Shot is on-hit magic damage ticking for 4 seconds, which is why MR and not HP is the buy.
audit.corrected: 7s written into whys[4], mid and wants.you[0]; pull corrected; %HP replaced with the poison.
sources: kit file: teemo Q cd 7, E text

edits.after: His blind + on-hit poison + kite — build MR, Q3-pull him. K'Sante wins the Blinding Dart windows.

edits.before: His blind + %HP + kite — build MR, Q3-pull him.
edits.after: His blind + poison + kite — build MR, Q3-pull him.

edits.before: Your Q-W combo lands — W-charge through his kite into a Q3 knock-up — but he can pre-poison and walk, so it is an even skirmish, not a kill.
edits.after: Your Q-W combo lands — W through his kite into a Q3 pull — but Toxic Shot ticks for 4 seconds while he walks, so it is an even skirmish.

edits.before: All Out shreds his squishy frame: you gain range and penetration, he has no dash, and your R-dash runs him down when his blind is down.
edits.after: All Out shreds his squishy frame: R launches him through the wall, he has no dash back, and Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds.

edits.before: Your Q-W combo comes online: W to charge through his kite, then Q3 knock-up — your first window to actually touch him.
edits.after: Your Q-W combo comes online: W through his kite, then Q3's pull — your first window to actually touch him at all.

edits.before: All Out shreds his squishy frame: R-dash through, gain range and penetration, and he has no dash to escape once you commit.
edits.after: All Out shreds his squishy frame: R launches him through a wall and dashes after him, and he has no dash to escape it.

edits.before: Teemo owns Levels 1-2 outright — his Q blind shuts off your Q autos and your passive mark, and his passive move speed lets him kite the moment you step up, so you just last-hit at the tip of Q and accept the poison chip. Do not chase a Q into auto range he can simply blind; you have no W or E yet to close the gap. At Level 3 your Q-W combo finally comes online — bait the blind, W-charge to eat the distance, then Q3 for the knock-up — but he can still pre-poison and walk away, so it stays a coinflip skirmish.
edits.after: Teemo owns Levels 1-2 outright — Blinding Dart shuts off your autos and with them your passive mark, and Move Quick lets him kite the moment you step up, so last-hit at the tip of Q and accept the poison chip. Do not chase a Q into auto range he can simply blind; you have no W or E yet to close the gap. At Level 3 your Q-W combo finally comes online — bait the blind, W to eat the distance, then Q3 for the pull — but Toxic Shot keeps ticking as he walks, so it stays a coinflip skirmish.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a genuine even fight: you can W through his kite and stick a Q3, but his E poison and blind chip you back to neutral, so neither of you fully owns it. Level 6 is your one clean spike — All Out converts your tank stats into a duelist profile with bonus range and penetration, and Teemo's squishy frame has no dash to escape your R-dash; if you can W his commit and R through him with the blind down, you kill him. Hold that all-in for when his Q is on cooldown — blinding your R-empowered autos is the only thing that saves him.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a genuine even fight: you can W through his kite and stick a Q3, but Toxic Shot ticks for four seconds and the blind chips you back to neutral, so neither of you fully owns it. Level 6 is your one clean spike — All Out converts your tank stats into a duelist profile, and Teemo's squishy frame has no dash out of an R that launches him through a wall. Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds, so hold the all-in for that gap — blinding your empowered autos is the only thing that saves him.

edits.before: Bait the Q blind, then W-charge through his kite into a Q3 knock-up before it refreshes
edits.after: Bait Blinding Dart, then W through his kite into Q3's pull inside the 7s window

edits.before: Reach Level 6 and R-dash him down — his squishy frame folds to your duelist conversion and he has no escape
edits.after: Reach Level 6 and launch him through a wall with R — his squishy frame folds and he has no dash back
